# Neumann Monson

> Award-winning Iowa-based architecture and design firm specializing in sustainable, mission-driven design across civic, healthcare, and education sectors.

Neumann Monson Architects is a full-service architectural and interior design practice headquartered in Des Moines and Iowa City. The firm is known for its collaborative design process, commitment to sustainable building certifications (LEED, Living Building Challenge, WELL), and deep expertise in civic, institutional, and commercial projects throughout the Midwest.

## Key Topics

- Sustainable Design
- LEED Certification
- Living Building Challenge (LBC)
- Architectural Services
- Design Process
- Project Management
- Interior Design
- Master Planning
- Commercial Architecture
- Civic Architecture
- Building Consultation
- Iowa Architects
- Site Selection
- FFE Selection
- Feasibility Studies

## Project Portfolio

- [Design Solutions for Living Your Mission](https://neumannmonson.com/projects): Portfolio of Neumann Monson's design projects across civic, healthcare, and education sectors.
- [Des Moines Federal Courthouse](https://neumannmonson.com/des-moines-federal-courthouse): Case study of Des Moines Federal Courthouse civic architecture project.
- [219 East Grand - Des Moines](https://neumannmonson.com/219-east-grand): Award-winning mixed-use development project in Des Moines East Village.
- [The Stanley Center for Peace and Security](https://neumannmonson.com/the-stanley-center-for-peace-and-security): Living Building Challenge sustainable renovation project in Muscatine, Iowa.
- [Lone Tree Wellness Center - Case Study](https://neumannmonson.com/lone-tree-wellness-center-case-study): Case study demonstrating cost optimization and design solutions for wellness center.
